title: Tenant separation metrics export & compliance dossier generator
creator: Aisha Nair
description: Deliver an automated pipeline that computes a 'tenant isolation scorecard' for every dedicated tenant, bundles the underlying evidence artifacts (network zone assignments, node residency hashes, audit log snapshots, retention policy snapshots), and exports a signed compliance dossier in both machine-readable (JSON-LD) and human-readable (PDF) formats. Scope: 1) scoring engine that aggregates telemetry + config to produce a numerical isolation score and reasoned findings; 2) evidence collector that snapshots KV metadata, storage retention flags, and network topology for the timestamped interval; 3) dossier renderer & signer that attaches provenance metadata and a cryptographic digest; 4) scheduled exporters to S3 and internal reporting dashboard. Acceptance criteria: - Scorecard computed for 99% of active dedicated tenants in under 2h runtime for a daily run - Exported dossier contains at least 5 evidence types with provenance links and SHA-256 digests - Signed dossiers verifiable via the compliance public key and stored with per-tenant retention metadata - UI page in Console surface latest dossier and allow manual re-run. Deliverables: scoring service, evidence snapshotter, renderer/signer microservice, Console integration, docs and runbook.
implementation_notes: We will implement the scoring engine as a separate service (isolation-score) that subscribes to the residency/telemetry stream (kafka topic tenant-residency-events). Scoring rules are pluggable and will start with three signals: physical-location-assertions (node tags), active-shard-affinity, and cross-tenant egress flows. Each signal maps to a weighted subscore; final score is 0-100 with reasons array. Evidence collector will reuse existing retention-exporter code but must record object digests (SHA-256) and include timestamps and object references in the dossier manifest. The signer service will use the enterprise signing key stored in the KMS and publish verification entries to the sigstore-compatible transparency log. We will keep export size bounded by sampling large telemetry traces and including pointers to archived blobs. Performance mitigation: run nightly as a parallel fleet job, split by tenant buckets; incremental snapshots for tenants with no topology changes. Feature flags: runtime.enable_isolation_score and export.enable_signed_dossiers.
test_plan: Unit tests for scoring logic with synthetic topologies; integration tests that spin up a mini snapshotter and sign a mock dossier; end-to-end test in staging that runs exported dossier through the verification flow and inserts into Console; load test to validate daily job finishes within SLO. Backfill test data for 50 tenants with varied residency patterns. Include negative tests for missing telemetry and ensure dossier includes 'evidence not available' entries.
